summary: Join our Sustainable Sanitation and Hygiene Practices Training Course to gain essential skills for improving public health and environmental sustainability.
lede: Sanitation and hygiene training helps facility, program and operations professionals assess risks and keep toilets, handwashing stations and cleaning systems functioning across institutional and workplace settings. Participants learn to plan inclusive facilities, establish cleaning and maintenance routines, support behavior change, and monitor performance with audits, logs and corrective actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who plan, supervise, fund, or evaluate sanitation and hygiene improvements.
audience: NGO program managers and WASH officers
modules: Principles of Sustainable Sanitation and Hygiene
Hand Hygiene Systems That Get Used
Hygiene Behavior Change in Workplaces and Communities
Infection Prevention and Control Hygiene Foundations
Budgeting and Value for Money in Sanitation and Hygiene
prerequisites: Participants should have basic experience in facility management, public health, or program implementation. A fundamental understanding of workplace hygiene challenges is recommended.
